caption: The drawing depicts a wooden side table with an oval-shaped top surface in a light brown color. The table has four straight legs and a curved, cross-braced stretcher at the bottom connecting the legs. Beneath the tabletop is a rectangular storage compartment with a hinged door that is open, revealing the darkened interior. Below this compartment, there is a single drawer with a round knob, which is partially open. The wood grain is visible throughout the piece, and the background is a plain off-white or cream color. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Cellaret
